entries.summary: The local-living architecture became the active build direction with local-first, privacy, authority, and rollback constraints.
The private Brain gained persistent-conversation seams plus graph, timeline, and source-tunnel memory views.
Humanity source admission now fails closed before memory and preserves difficult testimony only as attributed quarantine evidence.
The same worldline admitted and answered an exact live continuity turn after the settled-history hot loop was removed from the one-second heartbeat.
The compatibility runtime gained causal stage traces, stable error codes, bounded telemetry, differential backups, and verified restore semantics.

The migration contract now binds CSLv3 semantics, a NIL timing graph, CSSLv3 compiled kernels, and meet-or-exceed promotion gates; the first deterministic Rust context shadow passed its focused tests and microbenchmark.
The simplified Apocky home, owner-gated Apocrypha route, Atlas, conversation constellations, and new icon family were promoted and exercised across desktop, Pixel, and iPhone viewports.
The corpus prototype reports 1,386 held conversations and 19,479 messages through aggregate and curated projections while raw bodies and unreviewed detail remain unpublished.
Muted text contrast was raised and the live conversation surface passed accessibility and overflow checks on desktop, Pixel, and iPhone viewports.
A reversible Windows migration package was built and verified locally; no public download is exposed until native signature and lifecycle gates pass.

claim_boundary: Public-safe change summaries only; runtime availability and release readiness require fresh direct observation.
